model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different llama models, Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT, as a function of the number of completions. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 20 to 27, with tick labels spaced at intervals of one unit. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage”, is also linear and ranges from 0.4 to 0.8, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The blue line represents Llama-3B, initially positioned at a coverage value of approximately 0.42 at 21 completions, gradually increasing to a coverage value of approximately 0.72 at 27 completions. The green line represents Llama-3B + FT, starting at a coverage value of approximately 0.38 at 21 completions and reaching a coverage value of approximately 0.78 at 27 completions. The cyan line depicts Llama-1B, beginning at a coverage value of approximately 0.33 at 21 completions and rising to a coverage value of approximately 0.63 at 27 completions. The light green line illustrates Llama-1B + FT, starting at a coverage value of approximately 0.31 at 21 completions and achieving a coverage value of approximately 0.61 at 27 completions.
